events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $1.13 (model confidence 0.83)
events.body:
The trip is a RydeTAXI metered trip (F6), so extra distance enters the fare directly [RD-2]. One off-route segment is recorded: 22:57–23:01, 2.19 km driven against 1.38 km optimal, +0.80 km [F3], and the driver's own statement confirms he chose it himself ("I went round it") [F10], so RD-1 is engaged for that segment [RD-1].

The driver's asserted reason does not qualify under RD-4: the only traffic records before the segment are speed-band observations — Ayer Rajah Expressway and Central Expressway at band 1 [F11][F12] — and no incident is recorded near the route [F14]. A band alone does not exempt a segment [RD-4], so this is not a reasonable-cause detour [RD-4].

Consent is not established. The complete chat record holds only two messages, both about the pickup (rider at the main entrance, driver arriving in 2 min) [F7][F8][F9]; the driver's claim that the expressway was crawling and he went round it appears only in his post-trip statement, which is not rider consent [F10][RD-5]. Because the chat is complete and contains no rider agreement before the segment started, the finding is "counts" [RD-5]. No rider-named stop appears anywhere in the record, so RD-3 does not exempt the segment [RD-3].

Amount: the segment added 0.80 km [F3]; the RydeTAXI per-km rate is the metered distance fare over the metered distance, $17.50 ÷ 12.4 km = $1.4113/km [F6], applied per the refund formula at $1.4102/km → 0.80 × $1.4102 = $1.13. The complaint's 1.6 km figure [F1] is not used, because RD-2 refunds only the non-exempt segment's extra km, not the 0.25 km map-matching residue; the total billed excess $2.33 [F4] therefore is reduced to $1.13 [RD-2]. The rider moreover asked for no_action, which the record's RD-1 breach does not support.

RIDER: We looked into your trip and found the driver took a detour that was not covered by any traffic problem or by anything agreed with you beforehand. Because this was a metered taxi trip, the extra distance was added to your fare.

We are refunding $1.13 for the extra distance on that stretch. It comes as a Ryde voucher on your account, not a card refund.

Thanks for flagging it — your report is on file and the driver's record has been noted. Nothing further is needed from you.

DRIVER: We reviewed the trip and found you took a detour around the expressway without the rider agreeing to it beforehand, and no traffic incident on the route supports it. In a metered taxi trip that extra distance goes straight into the rider's fare.

As a result, $1.13 is being refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher, and a detour breach is noted on your account record.

No action is needed from you right now. Please keep to the route shown, or confirm any change with the rider in the app before you make it, so this doesn't build up on your record.
